question: The ‘Blue Flag’ certification is given to which of the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Environment-friendly beaches**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **‘Blue Flag’ Certification:** It is an internationally recognized eco-label awarded to beaches, marinas, and sustainable boating tourism operators.
 
• This certification is granted by the **Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE)**, which is a non-governmental, non-profit organization based in Denmark.
 
• The certification aims to promote sustainable development in the coastal areas through criteria related to **water quality, environmental management, safety, and eco-education.**
 
• Environment-friendly beaches must meet stringent standards to receive the Blue Flag certification, ensuring they are clean, safe, and environmentally sustainable. *Hence, the correct answer is Environment-friendly beaches.*
 
• The program is highly respected and serves as a benchmark for eco-tourism and sustainable environmental practices globally.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Criteria for Blue Flag Certification:**

 
 
• Beaches must meet **33 stringent criteria** spanning four categories: **environmental education and information, water quality, environmental management, and safety and services.**
 
• Examples include ensuring clean water, waste management systems, safety measures, and accessibility for all.
 
 
 
• **Global Recognition:**
 
 
• The Blue Flag program is operational across **50 countries**, making it a globally recognized standard for eco-friendly beaches and marinas.
 
• **Examples:** Blue Flag-certified beaches can be found in countries such as **Spain, Greece, South Africa, and India.**
 
 
 
• **India’s Blue Flag Beaches:**
 
 
• India has several beaches certified under the Blue Flag program, including **Shivrajpur Beach (Gujarat), Golden Beach (Odisha), and Kasarkod Beach (Karnataka).**
 
• The certification reflects India’s efforts to ensure **sustainable tourism** and environmental conservation along its coastline.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] 

**Important Points__**

 
• **Foundation for Environmental Education (FEE):**

 
 
• Established in **1981**, FEE operates across **77 countries** and is dedicated to promoting sustainable development through educational programs.
 
• The Blue Flag program is one of its most prestigious initiatives.
 
 
 
• **Blue Flag Beaches in India:**
 
 
• India joined the Blue Flag program in **2018** and is actively working to certify more beaches under this eco-label.
 
• The certification is part of the **Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change's “BEAMS” initiative.**
